datasets.title: Nyarugenge population by residence, 2022
datasets.description: Resident population enumerated in the Fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census, by urban and rural residence.
datasets.sourceName: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
notes: Historical census enumeration, not a current population estimate.
District totals do not support sector-level mapping.
Urban and rural residence are published counts.
